description: Regression for the bug found in a real trace: cti-mailer --check says OWNER_ALLOW_DOMAINS is unset and 'will not send', while the owner lane's own journal shows it sent reports today. The beat must not escalate the lane as broken.
seen_in: checkin-20261118T103109 (the old --check line, fixed in 127d431; the beat saved it to memory as fact)

cti-mailer.out:
version: 1.6.5
config: /etc/cti-agent/fleet.env
  OK   TENANT_ID
  OK   GRAPH_MAILBOX
  none OWNER_ALLOW_DOMAINS    --lane owner: domains an app owner or watcher may be at; unset means it will not send
token OK; roles: Mail.ReadWrite OK, Mail.Send OK

journal.cti-agent-appowners.service:
{{journal:-165m}} fleetbox run-appowners[4111]: [run-appowners] start
{{journal:-164m}} fleetbox run-appowners[4111]: [cti-mailer] owner lane: armed - 6 allowed domain(s) in the allowed domains in owners.db
{{journal:-163m}} fleetbox run-appowners[4111]: [run-appowners] 3 report(s) sent, 0 not sent
{{journal:-163m}} fleetbox run-appowners[4111]: [run-appowners] done

must.why: the lane demonstrably sent today; a settings line is not evidence it is off

should.why: it should not repeat the misleading line as a finding
